retrieved_context: Rick and Morty (season 2): The second season of the animated television series "Rick and Morty" originally aired in the United States on Cartoon Network's late night programming block, Adult Swim, which premiered on July 26, 2015 with "A Rickle in Time", and concluded on October 4 with "The Wedding Squanchers".  This season aired a total of ten episodes.

Justin Roiland: Justin Roiland (born February 21, 1980) is an American actor, animator, writer, producer, and director.  He is best known as the co-creator and executive producer of the Adult Swim animated series "Rick and Morty", in which he voices both of the show's eponymous characters, the voice of Oscar on the Disney Channel's animated television show "Fish Hooks", as well as the Earl of Lemongrab on Cartoon Network's "Adventure Time", and several characters (most notably Blendin Blandin) on "Gravity Falls".

A Rickle in Time: "A Rickle in Time" is the first episode in the second season of the American animated television sitcom "Rick and Morty", and the twelfth overall episode of the series.  Written by Matt Roller and directed by Wes Archer, the episode first aired on Adult Swim in the United States on July 26, 2015.
